formal_role: Defines the variable over which accumulation was first expressed
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies the original scale of the modeled process
review_warning: Unclear original variables make transformed accumulation impossible to audit

formal_role: Defines the new variable used for the change of variables
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies the new scale clock coordinate or state representation
review_warning: A transformed variable without interpretation can obscure model meaning

formal_role: The derivative of the transformation converts differentials between variables
review_warning: Omitting the scale factor usually changes units and accumulated totals

formal_role: Original bounds must be mapped into bounds for the new variable
review_warning: Keeping old bounds after changing variables mixes incompatible intervals

formal_role: The transformation may preserve orientation reverse orientation or require piecewise treatment
systems_modeling_role: Prevents path-dependent or nonmonotonic transformations from being misread
review_warning: Nonmonotonic transformations may require splitting the interval or adding state information
